column1: # SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI Ⅴ: ATLUS, Unreal Engine 4.23 (legacy version 8 paks, zlib, half the files encrypted), SDK 9.3.1, NVN, CRIWARE (ADX2 sound, Sofdec movies); base game 1.0.0.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents): the opening and the first school level
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (main imports from it)
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the game caps Unreal at 30 twice. Its code sets t.MaxFPS 30 at run time (its config has no t.MaxFPS or FrameRateLimit; frame smoothing is off in
# Engine/Config/Switch/SwitchEngine.ini), and the engine's Switch device profile sets rhi.syncinterval=2 (BaseSwitchDeviceProfiles.ini), the present interval 2 it asks for while

# r.VSync=1 locks presents to vsync. The host writes t.MaxFPS 60 and rhi.SyncInterval 1 into its console variables, which the rewriter finds by name (hle_fpslock.c, dm/tools/ue_cvar.py); rhi.SyncInterval 1 alone left it at 30. Unreal steps
# the game by the time that really passed.
# DM_FPS_TARGET=30 (Documents/env.txt on the iPhone, or the settings screen) keeps the game's 30 and saves power
# a 3D game: D-pad, right stick (camera) and L3 / R3 on the iPhone's virtual gamepad
# Unreal Engine 4.23: nninitStartup (main+0x1885750) reserves one address region for the whole engine, 62 GB by default; the rewriter's engine-wide gate on the store of its size

# (dm/tools/ue_region.py, its second pass: this build's size variable is a global apart from the base; hle_svc.c) gives it what the alias region has room for, 4.06 GB. Its FMallocBinned3 would take 37 GB of that region, so its

# constructor call is cut (the rewriter's engine-wide cut, dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and the engine's allocations go to a host malloc zone outside the guest block (dm/host/hle_uemalloc.c). The SDK-wide rules on the SDK 9.3.1 build (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py)

# put the region 64 MB into the alias region: the node area 62 MB instead of 1 GB, and regions of 4 MB and more 2 MB aligned instead of by their size (1 GB for this one). Engage's 5 GB block: 256 MB in front +
# 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region (the game asks for a 4 MB heap)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# The engine's global shaders (Engine/GlobalShaderCache-GLSL_SWITCH.bin), the engine's own materials and the game's, inline in the cooked packages (as DRAGON QUEST XI S); the paks are
# zlib-compressed, and half their files AES-encrypted with the key the game's code holds (uepak.py code_keys). The note is still the provisional profile's: shader_* keys are part of
# every shader's cache key (dmsh_chain.profile_rows), and the libraries were built with it
